about_the_game:
Sinner’s Grimoire

Descend into the deepest circles of Hell and fight your way out, one spell at a time.
Trapped in the Ninth Circle, you are a condemned magician wielding a cursed grimoire, your only hope to break free from eternal damnation. Craft devastating spell combinations, bend the infernal elements to your will, and carve your escape from the underworld in this fast-paced horde survival roguelite.

Key Features

🔥 Spellcraft Without Limits
Wield a modular grimoire that lets you combine and chain spells in endless ways. Modify projectiles, add elemental effects, and create unique synergies with every run. Your creativity is your deadliest weapon.

⚔ Survive the Circles of Hell
Face relentless waves of demons, traitors, and monstrosities born from Dante’s Inferno. Every floor introduces new enemy types, attack patterns, and environmental hazards.

🏆 Roguelite Progression
Earn forbidden knowledge with each escape attempt. Unlock new spells, upgrade your grimoire, and gain permanent traits that reshape your playstyle.

🕱 Epic Boss Battles
Challenge the wardens of each Circle corrupted kings, eternal betrayers, and ancient horrors who guard your path to freedom. Learn their mechanics, exploit their weaknesses, and claim their power.

🕰 Tense, Timed Runs
Each floor lasts six minutes of relentless combat. Enemies spawn every ten seconds, pushing you to adapt, strategize, and make every moment count.

🎨 Infernal Atmosphere
Immerse yourself in a richly detailed pixel art vision of Hell from frozen wastelands to rivers of fire, each Circle is hand-crafted with unique hazards and visuals inspired by The Divine Comedy.

📜 Build Variety & Replayability
No two runs are the same. Experiment with hundreds of possible spell combinations, traits, and upgrades to discover devastating synergies or die trying.

Do you have what it takes to escape eternal torment?
The Ninth Circle awaits…

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ or Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any that can play Black Metal
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Game runs on most low-end PCs and laptops.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD R7 370 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any that can play Black Metal
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for playing at higher resolutions (1080p+) or with post-processing enabled.

short_description: Descend through the Nine Circles of Hell as a forsaken spellcaster bound to a cursed grimoire. Unleash chaotic magic, dodge relentless hordes, and craft devastating spell combinations in this infernal bullet-hell survivor. Only the damned survive.
